body.name: Su--Li stratified rank-score specification
body.construction: For the fixed partition \(\mathcal{U}=\{U_1,\ldots,U_S\}\), fix each order \(\prec_s\) before \(X\) is drawn, equivalently condition on within-stratum unit permutations sampled independently of \(X\). Let \(R_{su}(y)\) be the ascending rank of \(y_u\) within \(U_s\), resolving every tie deterministically by \(\prec_s\). For nondecreasing functions \(\phi_s\), set \(T_{\mathrm S}(x,y)=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\sum_{u\in U_s}Z_u(x)\phi_s(R_{su}(y))\).
